Marta: Hey all — need final facilitation roster & AV/tech checklist for the annual planning retreat (Jun 3-4). I created a draft in the doc: https://docs.example/retreat-draft. Can leads confirm by EOD Wed? @Caroline @Anil

Caroline: Confirmed. I’ll take Day 1 plenary facilitation + can be backup for a breakout. I’ll need a mic and a clicker. :loud_sound:

Anil: I’ll run breakout B (roadmapping/prioritization). Can we get a projector + 2 breakout mics? Also request a 20-min async prework review slot during Day 1.

Kevin: I’ll own the Miro templates + prompt the prework Qs during intro. Will post links in #docs. Need laptop HDMI adapter.

Leah: I’ll coordinate logistics and create attendee checklist (travel, dietary, prep). Also can run a scheduling poll for any final session time conflicts.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Redwood Annual Planning Retreat  Jun 3 09:00-17:00, Jun 4 09:00-15:00". Invite link: https://calendar.example/abc123

Marta: Great. Two asks: 1) who can run a 60-min "customer ask triage" exercise? 2) AV tech check window  can we do Mon Jun 1 16:00-17:00?

Caroline: I can run the triage exercise. Prep plan: 10-min framing + 45-min group work + 5-min debrief.

Anil: AV check Mon 16:00-17:00 works for me. Who's bringing the HDMI dongles? @Kevin

Kevin: I’ll bring dongles and an HDMI->USB capture for remote folks. Also I can run the Zoom scene switching (I have a quick script).

Marta: Kevin please post the Zoom scene script here. Also Caroline, can you draft two prompts for the triage exercise? Minimal bullets are fine.

Kevin: Sure, quick script below:
```bash
# simple OBS/scene switch example for plenary -> breakout
obs-cli --scene \"Plenary\" && obs-cli --scene \"Breakout B\"
# fallback: use Zoom rooms layout toggles or manual host switching
```

Caroline: Draft prompts:
- "Pick one customer ask that currently blocks growth; 1-sentence impact + 1-sentence solution."
- "Rank tradeoffs: speed vs. quality vs. cost for that ask (assign 0-5)."

Leah: I’ll publish attendee pre-read by Friday morning. One more question: backup facilitation if someone is sick  can we have a 1-page runbook? Who volunteers to be the backups?

Anil: I can be backup for breakout B. Kevin can back up the Miro facilitation.

Marta: Owners recap (please correct if wrong): Plenary  Caroline (backup Marta); Breakout A  Marta (backup Caroline); Breakout B  Anil (backup Kevin); Miro/templates  Kevin; Logistics & pre-read  Leah.

ops-bot: Reminder: Please RSVP in calendar. AV vendor contact: av-team@example.com

Marta: Thanks everyone. Last thing: launch criteria discussion needs a 30-min slot on Day 2 AM. Caroline can you draft agenda bullets? Also post any dependencies (data, infra) in this thread.

Caroline: Will do. Draft bullets by Thu. Quick note: we need an infra smoke test by May 28 so launch criteria can be validated. @Anil can you confirm infra availability?

Anil: Confirmed  infra team will run smoke test and share results in #eng-releases by May 29.

Marta: Perfect. If no objections I’ll lock the facilitator roster and send the facilitation one-pager by Friday. :thumbsup:
